qualification: Finite-time 2D startup on 128 x 128 MAC cells, dt*=0.01, t*=0..10. Re >= 3200 remains strongly mesh-sensitive: matched 64-to-128 velocity differences are 17-70% at t*=10. These are provisional finite-grid teaching trajectories, not mesh-independent predictions, steady Ghia validation, or 3D turbulence evidence.
selection_basis: Same solver/physics/time schedule for all seven Reynolds numbers; finer common mesh selected after large 32-to-64 differences. No parameter tuning to match the illustrative video.
